name: Warehouse robots in service
summary: These are mobile robots that move goods inside mapped warehouses and fulfillment centers — not general household robots. As more sites automate, the global fleet has grown quickly, on the order of tens of percent per year. People still supervise the sites. The chart is an index of robots in service worldwide — higher means more machines deployed.
trendSummary: Mobile warehouse robot fleets grew rapidly across fulfillment and hospital logistics sites.
